sentences.en: The murderer was convicted and sentenced to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 这名杀人犯被判有罪并被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: The police are hunting an escaped convict in this area.
sentences.zh: 警察正在这个地区搜捕一名逃犯。

sentences.en: There wasn't enough evidence to convict him of the crime.
sentences.zh: 没有足够的证据来证明他犯了这桩罪行。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（加强）+vict（征服）→征服罪犯→宣判…有罪
